outcome: preterm infants (<37 weeks of gestational age)
cohort: The study included 380 puerperal women who gave birth at a public maternity hospital in northeastern Brazil.
finding: Women with less than four prenatal visits had 2.76-fold higher odds of giving birth to infants weighing less than 2500 g, independently of maternal and gestational ages, and were more likely to give birth to premature babies.
